messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up  HeliosCare sent back the vendor security questionnaire. They requested a short dataflow + confirmation of SOC2 scope and KMS usage before renewal next week.
Tom (Onboarding): Quick: do they want full infra or only PHI/PII paths?
Maya (CS): Only PHI paths + storage/retention/delete process. Also asked about regional residency (US vs EU).
Raj (SRE): We host them in us-west-2. I can draft a minimal diagram and retention bullets.
Nina (Legal): Add statement: SOC2 covers Logging, Change Management, and Incident Response. Also confirm that embeddings can be purged on request and note deletion SLA.
Tom (Onboarding): Draft snippet for dataflow:
```
client -> api.redwood.com (HTTPS)
-> ingress (us-west-2)
-> s3-us-west-2 (server-side-encryption, KMS=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:key/abcd)
-> hosted-gpu-pool (ephemeral KV cache)
-> audit logs -> log-archive (retention 30d)
Retention: embeddings/model-outputs=90d (default); logs=30d
Deletion: automated purge job (90d) + manual support deletion SLA=48h
```
InfraBot: Subprocessor list available: drive:/shared/subprocessors/2025-q1.csv
Maya (CS): I'll assemble attachments (png + csv) and send to customer with a short cover note. Nina, please sign off if okay.
Nina (Legal): Fine with wording. One edit: change 'embeddings/model-outputs' to 'model outputs (including embeddings)'.
Tom (Onboarding): Attached: `helios-dataflow-1030.png`, `helios-subprocessors-1030.csv`. Uploaded to drive.
Maya (CS): Sent to customer: cover note + attachments + offer for 10-min sync. Customer replied: "Thanks  looks good, would like a 10-min call Mon."
Maya (CS): Closing thread: Legal signed off, assets delivered, call scheduled.
